ai_trust_hero_desc: The AI engine does not grade or provide final project approval — that is strictly your teacher's role. The assistant aims to provide an immediate, unbiased mirror before submission to make your proposal as strong as possible.
audience_broad_nudge: Too broad target audience — try specifying it more concretely.
ai_trust_radar_heading: What exactly does the Idea Maturity Radar measure?
trust_dim_focus_desc: The model splits your text into sentences and computes their semantic center (vector centroid). If any sentence drifts from the core message, the system highlights it so the problem statement remains sharp and unambiguous.
trust_dim_audience_desc: The algorithm clusters user groups and compares them against calibrated anchors. It rewards specific and narrowly defined audiences (e.g. academic year, department, role) and recommends concretizing generic descriptions like «for everyone».
trust_dim_alignment_desc: Measures the semantic proximity between the problem vector and your solution vector. Ensures that the proposed product directly addresses the stated problem rather than drifting to an unrelated topic.
trust_dim_uniqueness_desc: Evaluates semantic proximity of your problem and target audience against existing projects in the university database using two-stage vector search. Rewards projects addressing unique challenges without direct overlap.
trust_dim_evidence_desc: Scans for specific metrics, percentages, figures, pricing, and survey or research citations. A factually substantiated problem carries significantly higher credibility in real-world environments.
ai_trust_deterministic_note: Models operate deterministically based on local semantic vector representations.
ai_trust_privacy_note: Your project texts are never sent to third-party commercial providers for public model training.
unarchive_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to restore project "{{title}}" from archive? The project will become active again.
